subject.title: fix(slack): clear room history after replies

question: Should Slack always-on room history clear only after a confirmed visible Slack reply, or should this PR intentionally change it to clear after any successful dispatch?
rationale: Current docs and tests allow rolling always-on room history, while the issue and PR target reply-bounded semantics; the exact compatibility boundary needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Clear only after visible reply
options.body: Move the clear boundary to a Slack-visible-delivery path or add a dispatch-result gate so silent turns keep pending room context until an actual reply lands.

options.title: Accept dispatch-boundary clearing
options.body: Land the broader behavior intentionally, update docs/tests to say processed always-on turns clear after successful dispatch, and accept the compatibility change.

options.title: Keep rolling and relabel
options.body: Do not clear always-on Slack history; instead adjust prompt/docs wording so rolling context is no longer described as strictly since the last reply.

recommendation.title: Clear only after visible reply
recommendation.body: Move the clear boundary to a Slack-visible-delivery path or add a dispatch-result gate so silent turns keep pending room context until an actual reply lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Slack history gate, shared turn clear path, and docs/test context all blame to steipete's recent area work.
